[[File:RodianQuartermaster-GAW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] quartermaster]]

A '''quartermaster''', otherwise known as the '''ordnance officer''', '''supply officer''', or, more colloquially, the '''finder''', was an individual in a military who was in charge of supplying and provisioning other soldiers.
